0022600199.text: The Dallas Mavericks (4-4, 2-2 at home, 11th in the West) host the Brooklyn Nets (2-6, 1-3 on the road, 13th in the East), who enter on a one-game winning streak after a 2-6 start. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), while Brooklyn is missing Egor Demin (leg bruise). The Mavericks swept the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 123-114 win in Brooklyn on February 24, 2026, and the teams have not met yet this season.
